messages:
emma: i've pushed the updates for PR #482 — addressed the eviction race that CI caught, added a deterministic unit test and clarified the test comment. PTAL when you get a sec.
sam: thanks. can you paste the exact failing assertion/log you saw so i can compare to CI history?
emma: sure, the failing snippet was:
```
E 2026-03-09T22:45:11Z test_batching.py:87 AssertionError: expected evictions 3 but got 1
.../kv_cache/evict.py:234: eviction timeout exceeded
```
I adjusted the test to use a retry loop with an explicit timeout and added a short backoff. left a comment about why it's deterministic now.
jonah: code looks fine on quick scan. one naming nit on `maybe_eviction()` -> `should_evict()` but not a blocker.
maria: quick perf run locally shows no regression. i'd like to run a short canary under load before we merge though, to be safe on tail p99.
sam: +1 to a short canary. @emma can you add a canary checklist to the PR — load profile, metrics to watch, rollback criteria? also include the exact deploy command.
emma: added a checklist in the PR description: 1) canary at 60rps for 15m, 2) watch p95/p99 token latency and memory usage, 3) confirm eviction rate stays stable, 4) rollback if error rate or p99 increases >10%. included PromQL queries.
deploy-bot: Canary window open tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC. Command: `deploy canary --pr 482 --window 1h`. :bell:
jonah: that window works for me. can someone from infra watch first 10m?
maria: i'll cover the first 15m and run the eviction dashboard sweep.
sam: i'll do quick infra sanity checks and watch for memory/regressions. note: automatic fallback is configured to revert to model-variant-v3 if SLA is missed.
emma: re-requesting review after changes — @jonah @maria @sam PTAL :eyes:
jonah: approved, left the naming suggestion but non-blocking.
maria: approved, no perf regressions in my canary run.
sam: approved from infra, just flagged a short note to monitor heap in first 5m.
emma: thanks all — scheduling canary now. i'll post results in this thread after the window. if anything odd i'll trigger rollback and ping #incidents.
